name: Bernard J. Stang Jr.

notes: Husband of Aunt Joan Quinn, and father of Mark Stang (per Brendan Adams). He turned 90 in 2021 and was then the last living member of Barbara’s parents’ generation; she texted him several times a year. [Barbara McKeldin Adams, A Memoir, text line 3324]
Aged 9 in the 1940 census as Bernard J. Stang Jr., living with his parents Bernard and Catherine Stang and his sister Bernice and brother William at 3020 Clifton Park Terrace, Baltimore.
